title: My Recipes — Flexible Two-Week Rotation
intro: No mandatory Sunday cooking. Pick any recipe any day; each cooking session makes 3–4 complete portions. Groceries recalculate from the recipes you select.

gingerbeef.title: Ginger-soy beef, soba and broccoli

ingredients.detail: 45 mL for sauce + 30 mL for broccoli

steps: Boil water in a pot. Take EXACTLY two tied soba bundles of ~83 g each (166 g DRY total), not the whole 250 g pack. Cook for the package time and drain.
Microwave 450 g still-frozen broccoli with 30 mL (2 tbsp) water in a covered but vented bowl for 5–7 min. Stir and DRAIN extra water.
Mix ALL sauce in a small bowl: 45 mL soy sauce + 10 mL honey + 10 mL sesame oil + 2 tsp freshly grated ginger + 45 mL water. Stir until honey dissolves.
Heat a large skillet medium-high. Crumble in 450 g RAW ground beef and cook about 7–9 min, stirring until fully cooked (71°C / 160°F). Discard only excessive rendered fat.
Lower to medium. POUR ALL sauce onto the cooked beef; stir 2 min to coat.
Add ALL drained soba and broccoli to skillet; toss 1–2 min. Do not reserve any sauce for later.
Divide evenly into 3 containers. Each meal is COMPLETE; just reheat when needed.
gingerbeef.storage: Reheat covered to 74°C / 165°F. Noodles and sauce are already mixed in.

chili.title: Smoky turkey chili — complete meal

ingredients.detail: RAW weight; not 900 g from two packs

steps: Weigh exactly 600 g RAW ground turkey. If you bought two 450 g packs, set aside and freeze the remaining 300 g RAW; do not use both whole packs.
Dice 1 bell pepper and HALF a medium onion. Fully rinse and drain one 540 mL can black beans.
Heat 5 mL (1 tsp) olive oil over medium-high in a large pot. Cook pepper and half-onion 4–5 min.
Add 600 g ground turkey. Break into crumbles and cook about 7–10 min until completely cooked (74°C / 165°F).
Add exactly 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika and ½ tsp salt. Stir 30 sec.
Pour in the ENTIRE 796 mL can crushed tomatoes including liquid, plus ALL rinsed, drained black beans.
Bring to a gentle bubble, reduce to medium-low and simmer UNCOVERED for 20 min. Stir every 4–5 min; simmer 5 min longer if runny.
Taste after cooking, then divide into 4 similar bowls or containers. This chili is a complete meal, no rice required and nothing to add at serving.
chili.storage: Reheat covered to 74°C / 165°F. No extra preparation.

porkchop.title: Lemon-garlic pork chops, Starfrit fries and green beans
porkchop.equipment: Oven, Ninja air fryer, microwave, 1 oven tray, 2 bowls

ingredients.detail: RAW boneless weight: 3 servings of approximately 151 g
RAW weight; cut into ~1-cm fries using Starfrit fry cutter
15 mL (1 tbsp) potatoes + 10 mL (2 tsp) pork sauce
juice of one lemon, about 30–45 mL (2–3 tbsp)
½ tsp garlic powder; replaces 2 fresh garlic cloves
¼ tsp potatoes + ¼ tsp pork
2 tbsp to microwave green beans; DRAIN afterwards

steps: Preheat OVEN to 205°C / 400°F for pork chops. Prepare ONLY ONE parchment-lined oven tray. Set NINJA AIR FRY to 200°C / 400°F for potatoes; green beans will go in microwave.

Weigh exactly 600 g RAW regular potatoes. Wash thoroughly (peel optional), then use the Starfrit fry cutter to make ~1-cm-thick fries. Rinse in cold water to remove surface starch, then DRY thoroughly with a clean towel or paper towels. Toss with 15 mL (1 tbsp) olive oil + ¾ tsp smoked paprika + ¼ tsp salt.

Distribute 600 g fries between the Ninja's two baskets if necessary to prevent overcrowding. AIR FRY at 200°C / 400°F for about 18–23 min for ~1-cm thick fries (thinner fries can finish earlier). SHAKE baskets around minutes 7 and 14; check from 18 min onward. Add 2–5 min if not tender and golden. Potatoes do NOT go in the oven.

WHILE fries cook, mix ALL pork sauce in a small bowl: 22.5 mL (1½ tbsp) Dijon + 7.5 mL (1½ tsp) honey + juice of ONE whole lemon (~30–45 mL, or 2–3 tbsp) + ½ tsp garlic powder + 10 mL (2 tsp) olive oil + ¼ tsp salt + ¼ tsp black pepper. No fresh garlic or lime; reserve none of the sauce for later.

Arrange all 452 g RAW boneless pork chops on the ONE oven tray, without overlap. Brush ALL sauce over BOTH sides, reserve none for later. Bake at 205°C / 400°F for about 18–25 min depending on thickness, until thickest center reaches 71°C / 160°F. Remove promptly and rest 3 min.

Near the end, put 150 g still-FROZEN green beans in a microwave-safe bowl with 30 mL (2 tbsp) water. Cover loosely or vent the lid. Microwave about 3–5 min, stirring, until hot and tender, then DRAIN water.
Divide cooked pork, Ninja potatoes, and drained green beans evenly among EXACTLY THREE containers. Divide any fully cooked pork-pan juices across the three servings.
All THREE meals are COMPLETE with pork, sauce, potatoes and green beans. Add nothing when serving; only reheat the chosen portion covered to 74°C / 165°F.
porkchop.storage: 3 servings containing ~151 g RAW-equivalent pork each, plus 200 g RAW-equivalent potatoes and 50 g FROZEN-equivalent beans each. Sauce is already included. Cool quickly and refrigerate/freeze within 2 hours. Reheat covered to 74°C / 165°F.

fajitas.title: Chicken-thigh fajita rice-and-bean bowls
steps: Weigh exactly 150 g DRY rice on a scale (NOT the rice-cooker cup). Add water per rice packaging and start rice cooker. Divide finished rice into 4 servings.
Cut 600 g RAW BONELESS SKINLESS chicken thighs into 2-cm cubes. Slice 2 peppers and 1 onion into ~1-cm strips. Rinse and drain the entire 540 mL black bean can.
Mix EXACTLY 2 tsp smoked paprika + 1 tsp cumin + ½ tsp chili powder + ½ tsp salt in a bowl.
Heat 15 mL olive oil medium-high in large skillet. Cook chicken while stirring ~8–12 min, until thickest pieces reach 74°C / 165°F. Transfer fully cooked chicken to a clean plate.
Cook peppers and onion in same skillet 6–8 min. Return cooked chicken; add ALL spice mix, 120 mL salsa and ALL lime juice. Stir and bubble for 2 min.
Add ALL drained beans and stir 2 min to heat and coat. No salsa or lime is reserved for serving.
Divide all COOKED rice between 4 containers, then divide ALL chicken/vegetables/beans/salsa mixture evenly on top. Each gets chicken, rice, vegetables and sauce.
Complete meal: just reheat covered to 74°C / 165°F; nothing else to add.
fajitas.storage: Salsa, lime and spices are already in the meal. Reheat to 74°C / 165°F.

shakechoc.title: 3 chocolate-banana shakes (Wednesday)
shakechoc.equipment: Blender; make the three shakes separately
steps: Amounts above make THREE shakes, not one. Each shake: 30 g whey + 30 g dry oats + 1 banana + 15 g peanut butter + 5 g cocoa + 300 mL water.
For ONE shake, pour 300 mL water into blender. Add peeled banana, whey, dry oats, peanut butter and cocoa in measured amounts.
Blend 30–45 sec until smooth. Drink; make the other two when wanted in the same proportions.
You can premeasure the dry powders/oats, but three premixed shakes may not keep the same texture for days.
shakechoc.storage: Blend when drinking. A shake-only day is optional; eat a regular meal if too hungry.

koreanbeef.title: Soy-maple ground beef, rice and broccoli
steps: Weigh 135 g DRY rice and cook with the package-directed water. Divide COOKED rice among three meals.
Microwave 450 g frozen broccoli covered/vented with 30 mL water for 5–7 min, then DRAIN extra water.
Mix ALL sauce: 45 mL soy + 30 mL maple syrup + 10 mL sesame oil + 2 tsp grated ginger + 2 minced garlic cloves + 15 mL rice vinegar + 45 mL water.
Brown 450 g RAW ground beef in a skillet medium-high, breaking into crumbles ~7–9 min until 71°C / 160°F; remove only excessive fat.
Reduce heat to medium, add ALL sauce to beef, and stir 2–3 min to reduce slightly.
Add drained broccoli and toss 1–2 min. Reserve no sauce for serving.
Divide COOKED rice among 3 containers, then divide ALL beef/broccoli/sauce mix over rice. Just reheat when eating.
koreanbeef.storage: Everything is packaged together, sauce included. Reheat to 74°C / 165°F.

oregano.title: Lemon-oregano chicken and veggie rice
steps: Weigh 160 g DRY rice. Cook in rice cooker with water per packaging.
Cut 600 g RAW boneless skinless thighs into 2-cm chunks. Mince 3 garlic cloves. Leave 500 g Asian veg frozen.
Mix sauce: juice of 1 whole lemon (~30 mL), 2 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp salt, and 30 mL water. All goes into the cooking pan.
Heat 15 mL oil in large skillet over medium-high. Cook chicken while stirring 8–12 min until thickest chunks reach 74°C / 165°F.
Add 500 g frozen Asian vegetables. Cook 6–8 min, stirring, until hot and tender.
Add all 3 minced garlic cloves; stir 30 sec. Pour in ALL lemon-oregano mixture; reduce to medium and cook 2 min.
Divide COOKED rice among 4 containers and top evenly with all chicken, vegetables and pan juices. No finishing garnish is required.
oregano.storage: Sauce and vegetables are mixed in; reheat to 74°C / 165°F.

salmon.title: Maple-Dijon salmon with potatoes and green beans

ingredients.detail: ¼ tsp potatoes + ¼ tsp salmon

steps: Preheat OVEN to 200°C / 400°F and line a salmon baking tray with parchment.
Cut 600 g RAW potatoes into ~2-cm cubes. Toss with 10 mL olive oil and ¼ tsp salt. AIR FRY in Ninja at 200°C / 400°F for 20–25 min, shaking halfway.
Mix ALL glaze: 22.5 mL Dijon (1½ tbsp) + 10 mL maple (2 tsp) + 5 mL olive oil + ¼ tsp salt + ¼ tsp pepper.
Arrange 450 g RAW salmon (about three 150 g portions) on lined tray. Brush ALL sauce onto pieces; none left for later.
Bake salmon about 12–18 min, thickness-dependent, until thickest center reaches 70°C / 158°F. Remove promptly to avoid drying.
Microwave 450 g frozen green beans with 30 mL water in a vented covered bowl for ~5–7 min, then drain.
Divide cooked salmon, potatoes, beans and any fully cooked salmon-pan juices evenly among 3 containers. Sauce is already included.
Reheat covered to 74°C / 165°F. Salmon is best eaten relatively soon; organize fridge/freezer however suits you.
salmon.storage: Salmon is best reheated just once; only heat the portion being eaten.

tomatocurry.title: Tomato-coconut chicken curry with rice
steps: Weigh 160 g DRY rice and start rice cooker using water from package directions. Finished rice makes 4 portions.
Cut 600 g RAW boneless skinless chicken thighs into 2-cm chunks, mince 2 garlic cloves; keep 500 g Asian vegetables frozen.
Heat 5 mL (1 tsp) olive oil medium-high in a deep skillet/pot. Cook chicken 8–12 min, stirring, until thickest chunks are 74°C / 165°F.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and 30 mL (2 tbsp) red curry paste; stir 30–60 sec.
Pour in the ENTIRE 398 mL diced tomato can WITH juice, then the ENTIRE 400 mL light coconut milk can. Stir smooth.
Add 500 g frozen Asian vegetables. Bring to gentle bubble; simmer uncovered medium-low 12–15 min, stirring occasionally.
Divide all COOKED rice among 4 containers, then divide the ENTIRE chicken/vegetable/curry sauce batch evenly over the rice. Nothing to add when serving.
tomatocurry.storage: Rice and coconut-tomato sauce are fully assembled. Reheat to 74°C / 165°F.

shakeberry.title: 3 vanilla-berry shakes (Wednesday)

ingredients.detail: vanilla or plain: 30 g per shake

steps: Ingredients shown are for THREE shakes. For ONE: 30 g whey + 40 g dry oats + 150 g frozen mixed berries + 15 g peanut butter + 300 mL water.
Pour 300 mL water into blender; add oats, whey, frozen berries, and peanut butter.
Blend 45–60 sec until smooth. Only add a splash of water if needed for texture.
Repeat twice when ready for the other shakes; premeasure dry ingredients if useful.
shakeberry.storage: Blend when drinking. Shake-only day is optional if you want solid food.

groundturkey.name: Lean ground turkey
groundturkey.hint: If sold in 450 g packs, buy 2; freeze the remaining 300 g raw.

soba.name: Blue Dragon dry soba noodles
soba.hint: Two tied bundles of ~83 g each; NOT the whole 250 g pack.

assumptions: Meat weights are RAW; rice, soba and oats weights are DRY. Ingredient quantities are for the ENTIRE batch, not one serving.
All savoury meals already include their sauce and sides BEFORE storage. Only reheat when eating.
Wednesday may remain three-shake day. Weekend restaurant breakfasts are a habit, not scheduled mandatory meals.
Refrigerate/freeze perishable meals within 2 hours in shallow containers. Refrigerator ≤ 4°C; use refrigerated leftovers ideally within 2–3 days or freeze.
Reheat leftovers to 74°C / 165°F. Initial cooking: poultry 74°C, ground beef 71°C, pork 71°C, fish 70°C. Source: Health Canada.
